title: Elite Force SP command ordinals and acknowledgements
status: PARTIAL; sampled startup command/event mismatch resolved; both EF profiles remain development-gated

provenance.referenceLicense: STEF Game Source License; incompatible with incorporating its implementation into GPL
provenance.use: Behavioral observations only; independent engine implementation and owned probes; no proprietary code bytes or source incorporated

correction: SP ordinals replace timestamp filtering and acknowledgement inference. Preserve entering command, reset ordinal on enter, bounded replay of mutable first command, explicit acknowledgement and marshalled dropped-command flag. Other profile packet/callback contracts preserved.

platforms.windows: Windows x86, MSVC 19.44.35222; NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4060 Laptop GPU, driver 591.74; GLx/Vulkan/RTX raster
platforms.linux: Ubuntu 24.04.3 WSL, i686 GCC 13.3, Clang 18.1.3; private Xvfb and software Mesa; Holomatch only

linux.sanitizers: AddressSanitizer and UndefinedBehaviorSanitizer on new probes

fixtureInventory.selection: All supplied maps/*.bsp excluding hm_* and ctf_*; each has info_player_start; case-insensitive sorted pak precedence.

set sv_maxclients 4

wait 90

wait 120

status

load mdr_scene
wait 180
renderer_switch
screenshot preflight
wait 3
echo COMMAND_ORDINAL_PREFLIGHT_COMPLETE
quit

wait 60
set sv_pure 0
set g_gametype 0
set sv_maxclients 4
map hm_borg1
wait 120
addbot Munro 2
wait 90
map_restart 0
wait 180
renderer_switch
screenshot preflight
wait 3
echo COMMAND_ORDINAL_PREFLIGHT_COMPLETE
quit

manualStage.acceptance: Physical input, menu save/load and rebinding, listening, force-feedback hardware and campaign-wide acceptance remain pending. Sampled startup command and weapon timing now matches retail; snapshot packet identifiers differ and broader image parity remains open.
manualStage.commandOrdinalUpdate: Engine artifacts refreshed after the EF SP command-ordinal correction, native recovery fixtures, seven-profile header checks, full Windows suite and save/reload/map startup probes. Existing manual homes, saves, settings and launchers preserved.

commandOrdinalReadmeUpdate.scope: Current engine provenance paragraph only; user settings, saves and launchers unchanged

safety.homes: Independent writable homes, unchanged real installation
safety.display: Windowed private inactive Windows desktops; private Linux Xvfb/Mesa
safety.input: Mouse/joystick disabled; no keyboard/mouse control, injection or capture
safety.retention: Useful diagnostics retained under worktree .tmp/stvef-gaps and designated test homes

limits: Initial map scenes, not campaign traversal; five-pak inventory includes HD overlay.
Physical movement/look/fire, menu rebinding/save/load, subjective listening and feedback hardware pending.
Queried startup command/event fields match; snapshot packet numbers offset by one.
Native RT unavailable on x86 driver; RTX raster checks only.
Existing bad-CRC st_21.bik, missing paths/messhall warnings and wider Linux-suite failures unchanged.
Linux builds retain existing signedness warning at sv_snapshot.cpp:311 and other pre-existing warnings.
